sourceLore.details: Broken signal lantern braced against rain; spare iron-framed beacon hauled up scree, lit to guide Lantern Haven wagons.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable isolated foreground prop for AshenSpire, on genuine transparent alpha background. Polished hand-painted dark fantasy, weathered tactile surfaces, dark iron, aged brass and restrained ember-warm highlights, same painted language as the reference. Full object visible with generous transparent margins; no hard rectangular backing, background scenery, opaque backdrop, fake checkerboard, labels, lettering, UI, borders, logos, stat values, map coordinates or characters. Maintain clear silhouette readable on mobile. Do not add unrelated props.
Primary request: A portable road signal beacon for hauling up a ridge: tall battered iron cage frame around a plain oil wick burner and protected warm flame, with a sturdy low freestanding base and two practical carrying handles. Weathered dark iron, soot, restrained aged brass fittings, small cinder-warm light within glass apertures; a tool used in rain, not a regal relic. Show the entire frame/base/handles in a three-quarter view with transparent outside and through open frame gaps. It is a substantial portable beacon rather than a tiny decorative hanging lantern. No crest, writing, people, road background, extra supply objects or magical effect cloud.
